service.name: Soul and R&B band
service.serviceType: Soul and R&B cover band for company holiday parties, galas, after-parties and wedding receptions
service.description: A soul and R&B band singing Stevie Wonder, Aretha Franklin, Al Green, Bill Withers, Marvin Gaye and the Motown songbook, a quartet or a five to six piece with a horn, for company holiday parties, galas, after-parties, milestone birthdays and wedding receptions across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: What does the soul and R&B band play?
faqs.a: Stevie Wonder, Aretha Franklin, Al Green, Bill Withers, Marvin Gaye, Otis Redding, The Temptations and the Motown songbook, sung out front with a horn on the big choruses. It's booked through Signet Artists in Denver as a quartet or a five to six piece.

While people eat, the singer takes the ballads at a level the tables talk across. Once the floor opens it plays like a dance band, loud enough that the chorus reaches the back of a ballroom. The band sets the level to the space and the crowd, and if your venue has a sound limit, give us the number and the set stays under it.

faqs.q: How much space and power does it need?
faqs.a: The quartet sets up in about 14 by 10 feet on two dedicated 20-amp circuits and needs 90 minutes to set up. The five to six piece needs a little more width. Sound support that's the right size for the venue comes with every booking.

faqs.q: Can the band work around speeches and awards?
faqs.a: Yes. An announcement microphone is ready for the remarks and the thank-yous, and we plan the sets around your program with you so the music stops before the emcee reaches the microphone.

faqs.q: Can the band learn our first dance?
faqs.a: Yes. One learned song of your choosing comes with every booking, and for a wedding it's usually the first dance. If the night runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night.
